title: Learning rate: how big a step to take

steps.label: Same objective, same start
steps.pseudocode: Same objective and start; only the learning rate changes.

steps.label: A small learning rate: 0.02
steps.pseudocode: A small learning rate takes tiny steps.

steps.label: Small rate: safe but slow
steps.pseudocode: After 10 steps the weight is still far from 3.

steps.label: A good learning rate: 0.3
steps.pseudocode: A good learning rate takes big steps at first, then smaller ones.

steps.label: Good rate: fast and steady
steps.pseudocode: After 5 steps the weight is almost at the minimum.

steps.label: A large learning rate: 0.9
steps.pseudocode: A large learning rate jumps past the minimum on the first step.

steps.label: Overshoot and oscillation
steps.pseudocode: The weight bounces from side to side around the minimum.

steps.label: Too large: divergence
steps.pseudocode: With a learning rate above 1 each bounce is bigger and the loss grows.
